summary: Round-1 adversarial review of SuspiciousAlignment/Filter/Coordinate.lean against notes/research/filter_spec.md §1 and §4. SOUNDNESS: `scripts/leancheck` on the file exits 0 with no output (no errors, no warnings, ~12 s); `--build` succeeds (module replayed, olean up to date); grep finds no sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide/unsafe/implemented_by; a scratch meta-command ran `collectAxioms` on all 224 constants of the module (190 non-internal, incl. the one private lemma) — only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound occur, and no axiom is declared; `#print axioms` on 32 main theorems confirms this. COVERAGE: every definition (oddExt, cNextF, nu, momF, qF, pF, etaStarF, fCompareF, gradNorm, cNextVec, etaEff, Noise.noiseFree) is verbatim from the spec and uses Defs.lean's mom/sD/sB/theta/cNext/qCoef/pCoef/etaStar; statements 1.1-1.9 (incl. the SGD corollary and the comparison with Deng's Theorem 7, whose right-hand side was checked against tex 490-499), 4.1, 4.2 (both directions, scaling invariance, ray statement, p = 1 remark) are all present; 1.5 is stated for two arbitrary states; non-vacuity examples on Fin 2 include an explicit Muon state where the alignment increases for every 0 < η < 4/3. Nothing is declared unproven and nothing required is missing. FIDELITY: I re-implemented all definitions with Lean's conventions (x/0 = 0, sign 0 = 0, 0^0 = 1) in python and tested every Lean statement independently: exact rational arithmetic, 40000 random instances (d ≤ 6, tied eigenvalues, zero coefficients, isotropic states, η ∈ {|c_i|, 1/ν_i, η*, 0, negative}, 8 filters incl. sign-changing ones) for 1.1-1.9 under the Lean (weakened) hypotheses, and 60000 float instances for §4 (incl. ‖g‖ = 0 and p ∈ {0, 1/8, 1/2, 0.9, 1, 2, −1/2}); no violation. All deviations from the spec are in the direction of weaker hypotheses (bulk-only / dominant-only sign condition, proviso s(c⁺) > 0 proved instead of assumed, p < 1 dropped where not needed) or are genuinely necessary additions (0 < η in 4.2 and in the ray statement, ‖g‖ ≠ 0 ∨ p ≠ 1 in the HTMuon formula for η_eff, s^D, s^B > 0 in the SGD corollary), and each is documented in the fidelity note with a Lean counterexample or sharpness example; I reproduced the note's numerical counterexample for 4.2 at η < 0 and checked its cross-references (tex line numbers, EtaStarBounds names, name-clash statement). No hypothesis set is unsatisfiable (instantiations compile in a scratch file), no statement relies on division by zero, sqrt/rpow of negatives or ℕ-subtraction. VERDICT: accept — no blocker, no major issue; 8 minor points (two missing 'not-formalized' rows and small imprecisions in the fidelity note, one inaccurate docstring, optional extra examples / an `id` version of the p = 1 remark, file length).
